source.text: וַיְהִי־ה֞וּא בְּשַׁ֣עַר בִּנְיָמִ֗ן וְשָׁם֙ בַּ֣עַל פְּקִדֻ֔ת וּשְׁמוֹ֙ יִרְאִיָּ֔יה בֶּן־שֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֖ה בֶּן־חֲנַנְיָ֑ה וַיִּתְפֹּ֞שׂ אֶֽת־יִרְמְיָ֤הוּ הַנָּבִיא֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אֶל־הַכַּשְׂדִּ֖ים אַתָּ֥ה נֹפֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And he was at [the] gate of Benjamin, and there [was] a master of [the] guard, and his name [was] Irijah son of Shelemiah son of Hananiah; and he seized Jeremiah the prophet, saying: To the Chaldeans you [are] falling.

en.L: And he was at the Benjamin Gate, and a captain of the guard was there, and his name was Irijah son of Shelemiah son of Hananiah; and he seized Jeremiah the prophet, saying, "You are falling away to the Chaldeans!"
en.B: When he reached the Benjamin Gate, a captain of the guard named Irijah son of Shelemiah, son of Hananiah, was there. He arrested the prophet Jeremiah and said, "You are deserting to the Chaldeans!"
en.R: But when he reached the Benjamin Gate, the officer in charge of the guard stopped him. His name was Irijah son of Shelemiah, son of Hananiah. He arrested the prophet Jeremiah. "You are going over to the Babylonians!" he said.

es.L: Y cuando él estaba en la puerta de Benjamín, estaba allí un capitán de la guardia, cuyo nombre [era] Irías hijo de Selemías, hijo de Hananías; y prendió a Jeremías el profeta, diciendo: «¡Tú te pasas a los caldeos!».
es.B: Cuando llegó a la puerta de Benjamín, estaba allí un capitán de la guardia llamado Irías hijo de Selemías, hijo de Hananías. Él arrestó al profeta Jeremías y le dijo: «¡Te estás pasando a los caldeos!».
es.R: Pero cuando llegó a la puerta de Benjamín, el oficial encargado de la guardia lo detuvo. Se llamaba Irías hijo de Selemías, hijo de Hananías. Arrestó al profeta Jeremías y le dijo: «¡Te vas a pasar al lado de los babilonios!».

fr.L: Et il était à la porte de Benjamin, et il y avait là un chef de la garde, et son nom [était] Yiriya fils de Shélémia fils de Hanania ; et il saisit Jérémie le prophète, disant : « Tu passes aux Chaldéens ! »
fr.B: Quand il arriva à la porte de Benjamin, un chef de la garde nommé Yiriya fils de Shélémia, fils de Hanania, se trouvait là. Il arrêta le prophète Jérémie en disant : « Tu passes à l’ennemi, chez les Chaldéens ! »
fr.R: Mais quand il est arrivé à la porte de Benjamin, l’officier qui commandait la garde l’a arrêté. Il s’appelait Yiriya fils de Shélémia, fils de Hanania. Il a arrêté le prophète Jérémie. « Tu passes du côté des Babyloniens ! » lui a-t-il dit.

sw.L: Naye alipokuwa katika Lango la Benyamini, mkuu wa walinzi alikuwako huko, jina lake Iria mwana wa Shelemia mwana wa Hanania; naye akamkamata Yeremia nabii, kusema, "Unakimbilia kwa Wakaldayo!"
sw.B: Alipofika kwenye Lango la Benyamini, mkuu wa walinzi aitwaye Iria mwana wa Shelemia, mwana wa Hanania, alikuwa huko. Akamkamata nabii Yeremia, akasema, "Unawakimbilia Wakaldayo!"
sw.R: Lakini alipofika kwenye Lango la Benyamini, afisa aliyesimamia walinzi akamzuia. Jina lake lilikuwa Iria mwana wa Shelemia, mwana wa Hanania. Akamkamata nabii Yeremia, akasema, "Unajiunga na Wababeli!"

vi.L: Khi ông đến Cổng Bên-gia-min, ở đó có một đội trưởng lính canh, tên là Gi-rê-gia con trai Sê-lê-mia, con trai Ha-na-nia; người ấy bắt nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi mà nói: "Ông đang chạy sang người Canh-đê!"
vi.B: Khi ông đến Cổng Bên-gia-min, có một đội trưởng lính canh tên là Gi-rê-gia con trai Sê-lê-mia, con trai Ha-na-nia, ở đó. Người ấy bắt nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi và nói: "Ông định đào ngũ theo người Canh-đê!"
vi.R: Nhưng khi ông đến Cổng Bên-gia-min, viên sĩ quan chỉ huy toán lính canh chặn ông lại. Người ấy tên là Gi-rê-gia con trai Sê-lê-mia, con trai Ha-na-nia. Ông ta bắt nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi và nói: "Ông định theo quân Ba-by-lôn!"

ko.L: 그리고 그가 베냐민 문에 이르렀을 때, 거기에 경비대장이 있었는데 그의 이름은 하나냐의 손자요 셀레먀의 아들인 이리야였다. 그가 예언자 예레미야를 붙잡고 말했다. "너는 갈대아 사람들에게 넘어가려는 것이다!"
ko.B: 그가 베냐민 문에 이르렀을 때, 하나냐의 손자요 셀레먀의 아들인 이리야라는 경비대장이 거기에 있었다. 그는 예언자 예레미야를 붙잡고 말했다. "너는 갈대아 사람들에게 투항하려는 것이다!"
ko.R: 그러나 그가 베냐민 문에 이르렀을 때, 문을 지키는 경비대장이 그를 막았다. 그의 이름은 이리야였는데, 셀레먀의 아들이고 하나냐의 손자였다. 그는 예언자 예레미야를 붙잡고 말했다. "너는 바빌로니아 사람들 편으로 넘어가려는 것이다!"

pt.L: E ele estava na Porta de Benjamim, e ali [estava] um capitão da guarda, e o seu nome [era] Irias, filho de Selemias, filho de Hananias; e ele prendeu Jeremias, o profeta, dizendo: "Você está passando para os caldeus!"
pt.B: Quando ele chegou à Porta de Benjamim, estava ali um capitão da guarda chamado Irias, filho de Selemias, filho de Hananias. Ele prendeu o profeta Jeremias e disse: "Você está desertando para os caldeus!"
pt.R: Mas, quando Jeremias chegou à Porta de Benjamim, o oficial que comandava a guarda o deteve. O nome dele era Irias, filho de Selemias, filho de Hananias. Ele prendeu o profeta Jeremias. "Você está se passando para o lado dos babilônios!", disse ele.

am.L: በብንያም በር በነበረ ጊዜ በዚያ የዘበኞች አለቃ ነበረ፤ ስሙም የሐናንያ ልጅ የሰሌምያ ልጅ ይርእያ ነበረ፤ እርሱም፦ «ወደ ከለዳውያን ትከዳለህ!» ብሎ ነቢዩን ኤርምያስን ያዘው።
am.B: ወደ ብንያም በር በደረሰ ጊዜ የሐናንያ ልጅ የሰሌምያ ልጅ ይርእያ የተባለ የዘበኞች አለቃ በዚያ ነበረ። እርሱም ነቢዩን ኤርምያስን ይዞ፦ «ወደ ከለዳውያን ልትከዳ ነው!» አለው።
am.R: ወደ ብንያም በር በደረሰ ጊዜ ግን የዘበኞቹ አለቃ አስቆመው። ስሙ ይርእያ ነበር፤ እርሱም የሐናንያ የልጅ ልጅ የሰሌምያ ልጅ ነበር። ነቢዩን ኤርምያስን ያዘውና፦ «ወደ ባቢሎናውያን እየከዳህ ነው!» አለው።

hi.L: और जब वह बिन्यामीन के फाटक पर था, तो वहाँ पहरेदारों का एक प्रधान था, और उसका नाम यिरिय्याह था, जो हनन्याह के पुत्र शेलेम्याह का पुत्र था; और उसने यिर्मयाह भविष्यद्वक्ता को यह कहकर पकड़ लिया, "तुम कसदियों से जा मिल रहे हो!"
hi.B: जब वह बिन्यामीन के फाटक पर पहुँचा, तो वहाँ पहरेदारों का एक प्रधान था, जिसका नाम यिरिय्याह था, जो हनन्याह का पोता और शेलेम्याह का पुत्र था। उसने भविष्यद्वक्ता यिर्मयाह को पकड़ लिया और कहा, "तुम भागकर कसदियों से जा मिल रहे हो!"
hi.R: पर जब वह बिन्यामीन के फाटक पर पहुँचा, तो पहरेदारों के प्रधान ने उसे रोक लिया। उसका नाम यिरिय्याह था, जो शेलेम्याह का बेटा और हनन्याह का पोता था। उसने नबी यिर्मयाह को पकड़ लिया। "तुम बाबुलियों से मिलने जा रहे हो!" उसने कहा।

ru.L: И когда он был у Вениаминовых ворот, был там начальник стражи по имени Ирия, сын Шелемии, сына Ханании; и он схватил Иеремию пророка, говоря: «Ты перебегаешь к халдеям!»
ru.B: Когда он подошёл к Вениаминовым воротам, там был начальник стражи по имени Ирия, сын Шелемии, сына Ханании. Он задержал пророка Иеремию и сказал: «Ты перебегаешь к халдеям!»
ru.R: Но когда он дошёл до Вениаминовых ворот, его остановил начальник стражи. Его звали Ирия, сын Шелемии, сына Ханании. Он схватил пророка Иеремию. «Ты переходишь к вавилонянам!» — сказал он.

ja.L: 彼がベニヤミンの門に来たとき、そこに見張りの長がいた。その名はハナンヤの子シェレムヤの子イルイヤといった。彼は預言者エレミヤを捕らえて言った。「カルデア人のもとへ投降しようとしているな！」
ja.B: 彼がベニヤミンの門に着くと、ハナンヤの子シェレムヤの子イルイヤという見張りの長がそこにいた。彼は預言者エレミヤを捕らえて言った。「カルデア人のところへ寝返るつもりだな！」
ja.R: ところが、エレミヤがベニヤミンの門に着いたとき、見張りの責任者が彼を止めました。その人は、シェレムヤの息子で、ハナンヤの孫であるイルイヤでした。イルイヤは預言者エレミヤを捕まえました。「バビロン人の側につくつもりだな！」とイルイヤは言いました。

decisions.choice: the Benjamin Gate: a gate on the north side of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The gate took its name from the road north to the land of Benjamin, where Jeremiah was going (38:7; Zechariah 14:10). It is the city gate, not the upper Benjamin Gate of the temple named in 20:2.

decisions.choice: a captain of the guard: the officer in charge of the gate's watch
decisions.reason: The phrase means "master of the oversight", the man responsible for the guard at the gate. It occurs only here.

decisions.choice: falling to the Chaldeans: deserting to the enemy
decisions.reason: To "fall to" an army is to go over to it and give oneself up (21:9; 38:19; 39:9). Jeremiah had urged the people to surrender (21:9), so the charge looked likely. Leaving the city while the enemy was nearby made him a suspect.

decisions.choice: Irijah's grandfather Hananiah
decisions.reason: The text does not say whether this Hananiah is the prophet who opposed Jeremiah in chapter 28. The name was common, and nothing more is known of the family.

decisions.choice: deserting (B); going over to (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew verb "falling"; Balanced and Readable say what it means in this setting. Readable puts the officer's words after the arrest, in the order the reader needs.

decisions.choice: the Babylonians
decisions.reason: As in Isaiah and the rest of Jeremiah, Readable says "Babylonians" for "Chaldeans".

decisions.choice: te pasas (L); te estás pasando (B); te vas a pasar al lado de (R)
decisions.reason: "Falling to" an enemy is going over to his side; Spanish "pasarse a" says it at every level.

decisions.choice: "Unakimbilia kwa Wakaldayo" (L); "Unawakimbilia Wakaldayo" (B); "Unajiunga na Wababeli" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "fall to" means desert to the enemy; Swahili "kuanguka" would not carry that sense, so every level says "flee to" or "join".

decisions.choice: Gi-rê-gia
decisions.reason: A new name for these books, written in the usual pattern of the published transliterations.

decisions.choice: Irijah accuses Jeremiah in 해라체 ("너는"); Jeremiah answers him in 하오체 ("거짓말이오")
decisions.reason: A hostile arrest; Jeremiah answers a guard captain as one grown man to another.

decisions.choice: a Porta de Benjamim; passando para (L), desertando para (B), se passando para o lado dos (R)
decisions.reason: The city gate (m1) is "a Porta de Benjamim", with a capital as a name. The Hebrew verb "fall" to an army means going over to it (m3); Portuguese "cair para" says nothing of the kind, so Literal says "passar para", the words 21:9 uses for the same verb, and Balanced "desertar".

decisions.choice: "የብንያም በር" for the Benjamin Gate; "የዘበኞች አለቃ" for the captain of the guard
decisions.reason: Kept apart from "የዘበኞቹ አለቃ" of the king of Babylon (Nebuzaradan) only by the article; Irijah "ይርእያ" is new, from the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "ትከዳለህ" (you are deserting) for "falling to the Chaldeans"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: deserting to the enemy; "ወደቀ" would not carry that sense in Amharic.

decisions.choice: जा मिलना (L); भागकर जा मिलना (B); मिलने जाना (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "falling to" means deserting to the enemy; Hindi जा मिलना says it at every level, Balanced adding भागकर. Irijah, a guard officer, says तुम to the prophet he arrests.

decisions.choice: यिरिय्याह; पहरेदारों का प्रधान; बिन्यामीन का फाटक
decisions.reason: Irijah is transcribed from the Hebrew; the captain of the guard is पहरेदारों का प्रधान, kept apart from Nebuzaradan's अंगरक्षकों का प्रधान in Kings.

decisions.choice: Вениаминовы ворота; начальник стражи; Ирия, сын Шелемии, сына Ханании
decisions.reason: The Benjamin Gate on the north side of the city (meaning m1) in the traditional Russian form; Irijah is Ирия; Shelemiah and Hananiah keep the forms of Ezra and Nehemiah in this translation.

decisions.choice: перебегаешь (L, B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "falling to" the enemy means deserting (meaning m3); Russian "перебегать" is the word for a deserter, so Literal uses it too, and Readable says "переходишь".

decisions.choice: ba'al peqidut "見張りの長" (L, B), "見張りの責任者" (R); Yir'iyyah "イルイヤ"; nofel 'el-haKasdim "投降しようとしている" (L, as nofelim in 2 Kings 25:11), "寝返る" (B), "側につく" (R).
The officer's accusation is plain and leaves out the pronoun (no "おまえ"); Jeremiah answers him plainly in 37:14.
decisions.reason: Style guide §4: a natural register for each speaker.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֜הוּ שֶׁ֗קֶר אֵינֶ֤נִּי נֹפֵל֙ עַל־הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֵלָ֑יו וַיִּתְפֹּ֤שׂ יִרְאִיָּיה֙ בְּיִרְמְיָ֔הוּ וַיְבִאֵ֖הוּ אֶל־הַשָּׂרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Jeremiah: A lie! Not I [am] falling to the Chaldeans. And not he listened to him, and seized Irijah Jeremiah and brought him to the princes.

en.L: And Jeremiah said, "A lie! I am not falling away to the Chaldeans." But he did not listen to him, and Irijah seized Jeremiah and brought him to the princes.
en.B: "That is a lie!" Jeremiah said. "I am not deserting to the Chaldeans." Irijah refused to listen. He arrested Jeremiah and brought him to the officials.
en.R: "That is not true!" Jeremiah answered. "I am not going over to the Babylonians." But Irijah would not listen. He arrested Jeremiah and took him to the leaders.

es.L: Y Jeremías dijo: «¡Mentira! No me paso a los caldeos». Pero no lo escuchó, sino que Irías prendió a Jeremías y lo llevó a los príncipes.
es.B: «¡Eso es mentira!», dijo Jeremías. «No me estoy pasando a los caldeos». Pero Irías no quiso escucharlo. Arrestó a Jeremías y lo llevó ante los jefes.
es.R: «¡Eso no es cierto!», respondió Jeremías. «No me voy a pasar al lado de los babilonios». Pero Irías no le hizo caso. Arrestó a Jeremías y lo llevó ante los dirigentes.

fr.L: Et Jérémie dit : « Mensonge ! Je ne passe pas aux Chaldéens. » Mais il ne l’écouta pas, et Yiriya saisit Jérémie et l’amena aux princes.
fr.B: « C’est un mensonge ! dit Jérémie. Je ne passe pas aux Chaldéens. » Yiriya refusa de l’écouter. Il arrêta Jérémie et l’amena aux chefs.
fr.R: « Ce n’est pas vrai ! a répondu Jérémie. Je ne passe pas du côté des Babyloniens. » Mais Yiriya n’a pas voulu l’écouter. Il a arrêté Jérémie et l’a conduit devant les chefs.

sw.L: Naye Yeremia akasema, "Uongo! Mimi sikimbilii kwa Wakaldayo." Lakini hakumsikiliza; Iria akamkamata Yeremia, akamleta kwa wakuu.
sw.B: Yeremia akasema, "Huo ni uongo! Mimi siwakimbilii Wakaldayo." Lakini Iria alikataa kumsikiliza. Akamkamata Yeremia, akampeleka kwa maafisa.
sw.R: Yeremia akajibu, "Si kweli! Mimi sijiungi na Wababeli." Lakini Iria hakutaka kumsikiliza. Akamkamata Yeremia, akampeleka kwa viongozi.

vi.L: Giê-rê-mi nói: "Dối trá! Tôi không chạy sang người Canh-đê." Nhưng người ấy không nghe ông, và Gi-rê-gia bắt Giê-rê-mi đem đến các quan trưởng.
vi.B: Giê-rê-mi nói: "Nói dối! Tôi đâu có đào ngũ theo người Canh-đê." Nhưng Gi-rê-gia không chịu nghe. Ông ta bắt Giê-rê-mi và giải đến các quan chức.
vi.R: Giê-rê-mi trả lời: "Không đúng! Tôi không theo quân Ba-by-lôn." Nhưng Gi-rê-gia không chịu nghe. Ông ta bắt Giê-rê-mi và giải đến các nhà lãnh đạo.

ko.L: 그러자 예레미야가 말했다. "거짓말이오! 나는 갈대아 사람들에게 넘어가려는 것이 아니오." 그러나 그는 그의 말을 듣지 않았고, 이리야는 예레미야를 붙잡아 고관들에게 데려갔다.
ko.B: 예레미야가 말했다. "거짓말이오! 나는 갈대아 사람들에게 투항하려는 것이 아니오." 그러나 이리야는 들으려 하지 않고, 예레미야를 체포하여 관리들에게 끌고 갔다.
ko.R: 예레미야가 대답했다. "그렇지 않소! 나는 바빌로니아 사람들 편으로 넘어가려는 것이 아니오." 그러나 이리야는 들으려 하지 않았다. 그는 예레미야를 체포하여 지도자들에게 끌고 갔다.

pt.L: E Jeremias disse: "Mentira! Não estou passando para os caldeus." Mas ele não o ouviu, e Irias prendeu Jeremias e o levou aos príncipes.
pt.B: "É mentira!", disse Jeremias. "Não estou desertando para os caldeus." Irias não quis ouvi-lo. Ele prendeu Jeremias e o levou aos oficiais.
pt.R: "Isso não é verdade!", respondeu Jeremias. "Não estou me passando para o lado dos babilônios." Mas Irias não quis ouvir. Ele prendeu Jeremias e o levou aos líderes.

am.L: ኤርምያስም፦ «ሐሰት ነው! ወደ ከለዳውያን አልከዳም» አለ። እርሱ ግን አልሰማውም፤ ይርእያም ኤርምያስን ይዞ ወደ አለቆቹ አመጣው።
am.B: «ሐሰት ነው!» አለ ኤርምያስ። «ወደ ከለዳውያን አልከዳም።» ይርእያ ግን ሊሰማው አልፈለገም፤ ኤርምያስን ይዞ ወደ ሹማምንቱ አመጣው።
am.R: «ይህ እውነት አይደለም!» ብሎ ኤርምያስ መለሰ። «ወደ ባቢሎናውያን አልከዳም።» ይርእያ ግን ሊሰማው አልፈለገም። ኤርምያስን ይዞ ወደ መሪዎቹ ወሰደው።

hi.L: और यिर्मयाह ने कहा, "झूठ! मैं कसदियों से नहीं जा मिल रहा हूँ।" पर उसने उसकी न सुनी, और यिरिय्याह यिर्मयाह को पकड़कर हाकिमों के पास ले गया।
hi.B: "यह झूठ है!" यिर्मयाह ने कहा। "मैं भागकर कसदियों से नहीं जा मिल रहा हूँ।" पर यिरिय्याह ने उसकी सुनने से इनकार किया। उसने यिर्मयाह को पकड़ लिया और अधिकारियों के पास ले गया।
hi.R: "यह सच नहीं है!" यिर्मयाह ने उत्तर दिया। "मैं बाबुलियों से मिलने नहीं जा रहा हूँ।" पर यिरिय्याह ने उसकी एक न सुनी। उसने यिर्मयाह को पकड़ लिया और अगुवों के पास ले गया।

ru.L: И сказал Иеремия: «Ложь! Я не перебегаю к халдеям.» Но тот не послушал его, и схватил Ирия Иеремию, и привёл его к князьям.
ru.B: «Это ложь!» — сказал Иеремия. — «Я не перебегаю к халдеям.» Но Ирия не стал слушать. Он схватил Иеремию и привёл его к вельможам.
ru.R: «Это неправда!» — ответил Иеремия. — «Я не перехожу к вавилонянам.» Но Ирия не захотел слушать. Он схватил Иеремию и привёл его к начальникам.

ja.L: エレミヤは言った。「うそだ。わたしはカルデア人のもとへ投降しようとしてはいない。」しかし、イルイヤは彼に聞き従わず、エレミヤを捕らえて、長たちのもとに連れて行った。
ja.B: 「うそだ」とエレミヤは言った。「わたしはカルデア人のところへ寝返るつもりはない。」しかし、イルイヤは聞き入れなかった。彼はエレミヤを捕らえて、高官たちのところに連れて行った。
ja.R: 「それは違う」とエレミヤは答えました。「わたしはバビロン人の側につくつもりはない。」しかし、イルイヤは聞こうとしませんでした。イルイヤはエレミヤを捕まえて、指導者たちのところへ連れて行きました。

decisions.choice: A lie!: a flat denial
decisions.reason: The single word means falsehood. Jeremiah answers the charge with one word before he explains.

decisions.choice: the princes: the king's officials under Zedekiah
decisions.reason: Under Jehoiakim some of the court officials had protected Jeremiah (26:16, 24; 36:19). Many leading men had been taken to Babylon with Coniah (2 Kings 24:14-15). The officials who now hear his case treat him as a traitor (38:4).

decisions.choice: princes (L); officials (B); leaders (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this word in Jeremiah (as 26:10). These are the king's chief officers, not his sons.

decisions.choice: the Babylonians
decisions.reason: As in Isaiah and the rest of Jeremiah, Readable says "Babylonians" for "Chaldeans".

decisions.choice: हाकिम (L); अधिकारी (B); अगुवे (R)
decisions.reason: The king's sarim, as 32:32.

source.text: וַיִּקְצְפ֧וּ הַשָּׂרִ֛ים עַֽל־יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ וְהִכּ֣וּ אֹת֑וֹ וְנָתְנ֨וּ אוֹת֜וֹ בֵּ֣ית הָאֵס֗וּר בֵּ֚ית יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן הַסֹּפֵ֔ר כִּֽי־אֹת֥וֹ עָשׂ֖וּ לְבֵ֥ית הַכֶּֽלֶא׃

records.literal_gloss: And were angry the princes at Jeremiah, and they struck him and put him [in the] house of the fetter, [the] house of Jonathan the scribe; for it they had made into [the] house of the prison.

en.L: And the princes were angry with Jeremiah, and they struck him and put him in the house of confinement, the house of Jonathan the secretary, for they had made it into the prison.
en.B: The officials were furious with Jeremiah. They beat him and locked him up in the house of Jonathan the secretary, which they had turned into a prison.
en.R: The leaders were very angry with Jeremiah. They beat him and locked him up in the house of Jonathan, the royal secretary. They had turned his house into a prison.

es.L: Y se enojaron los príncipes contra Jeremías, y lo golpearon y lo pusieron en la casa de prisión, en la casa de Jonatán el escriba, porque la habían convertido en cárcel.
es.B: Los jefes se enfurecieron con Jeremías. Lo golpearon y lo encerraron en la casa de Jonatán el secretario, que habían convertido en cárcel.
es.R: Los dirigentes se enojaron mucho con Jeremías. Lo golpearon y lo encerraron en la casa de Jonatán, el secretario del rey. Habían convertido su casa en una cárcel.

fr.L: Et les princes s’irritèrent contre Jérémie, et ils le frappèrent et le mirent dans la maison de détention, la maison de Jonathan le secrétaire, car ils en avaient fait la prison.
fr.B: Les chefs furent furieux contre Jérémie. Ils le frappèrent et l’enfermèrent dans la maison de Jonathan le secrétaire, dont ils avaient fait une prison.
fr.R: Les chefs étaient très en colère contre Jérémie. Ils l’ont frappé et l’ont enfermé dans la maison de Jonathan, le secrétaire du roi. Ils avaient transformé sa maison en prison.

sw.L: Nao wakuu wakamkasirikia Yeremia, wakampiga, wakamtia katika nyumba ya kifungo, nyumba ya Yonathani mwandishi, kwa maana walikuwa wameifanya kuwa gereza.
sw.B: Maafisa walimkasirikia sana Yeremia. Wakampiga, wakamfunga katika nyumba ya Yonathani katibu, ambayo walikuwa wameifanya kuwa gereza.
sw.R: Viongozi walimkasirikia sana Yeremia. Wakampiga, wakamfunga katika nyumba ya Yonathani, katibu wa mfalme. Walikuwa wameifanya nyumba yake kuwa gereza.

vi.L: Các quan trưởng nổi giận với Giê-rê-mi; họ đánh ông và bỏ ông vào nhà giam, là nhà của Giô-na-than thư ký, vì họ đã biến nhà ấy thành nhà tù.
vi.B: Các quan chức giận dữ với Giê-rê-mi. Họ đánh đòn ông và giam ông trong nhà của Giô-na-than, thư ký triều đình, là nơi họ đã biến thành nhà tù.
vi.R: Các nhà lãnh đạo rất giận Giê-rê-mi. Họ đánh đòn ông và giam ông trong nhà của Giô-na-than, thư ký hoàng gia. Họ đã biến nhà ấy thành nhà tù.

ko.L: 그리고 고관들이 예레미야에게 화가 나서 그를 때리고, 그를 서기관 요나단의 집인 구금하는 집에 가두었다. 그들이 그 집을 감옥으로 만들었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 관리들은 예레미야에게 몹시 화가 나서, 그를 때리고 서기관 요나단의 집에 가두었다. 그들이 그 집을 감옥으로 쓰고 있었기 때문이다.
ko.R: 지도자들은 예레미야에게 몹시 화가 났다. 그들은 그를 때리고 왕의 서기관 요나단의 집에 가두었다. 그들은 그 집을 감옥으로 바꾸어 쓰고 있었다.

pt.L: E os príncipes ficaram irados com Jeremias, e o espancaram e o puseram na casa da detenção, a casa de Jônatas, o escrivão, pois a tinham transformado em prisão.
pt.B: Os oficiais ficaram furiosos com Jeremias. Eles o espancaram e o prenderam na casa de Jônatas, o secretário, que tinham transformado em prisão.
pt.R: Os líderes ficaram muito irados com Jeremias. Eles o espancaram e o prenderam na casa de Jônatas, o secretário do rei. Eles tinham transformado a casa dele numa prisão.

am.L: አለቆቹም በኤርምያስ ላይ ተቆጡ፤ መቱትም፤ በእስር ቤት፣ በጸሐፊው በዮናታን ቤት አኖሩት፤ እርሱን ወህኒ ቤት አድርገውት ነበርና።
am.B: ሹማምንቱ በኤርምያስ ላይ እጅግ ተቆጡ፤ ደበደቡትም፤ ወህኒ ቤት አድርገውት በነበረው በጸሐፊው በዮናታን ቤት አሰሩት።
am.R: መሪዎቹ በኤርምያስ ላይ እጅግ ተቆጡ። ደበደቡትም፤ በንጉሡ ጸሐፊ በዮናታን ቤት አሰሩት። የዮናታንን ቤት እስር ቤት አድርገውት ነበር።

hi.L: और हाकिम यिर्मयाह पर क्रोधित हुए, और उन्होंने उसे मारा और उसे योनातान लेखक के घर में, बंधन के घर में डाल दिया, क्योंकि उन्होंने उसे बंदीगृह बना दिया था।
hi.B: अधिकारी यिर्मयाह पर बहुत क्रोधित हुए। उन्होंने उसे पीटा और योनातान सचिव के घर में बंद कर दिया, जिसे उन्होंने बंदीगृह बना दिया था।
hi.R: अगुवे यिर्मयाह पर बहुत क्रोधित हुए। उन्होंने उसे पीटा और राजा के सचिव योनातान के घर में बंद कर दिया। उन्होंने उसके घर को जेल बना दिया था।

ru.L: И разгневались князья на Иеремию, и били его, и посадили его в дом заключения, в дом Ионафана, писца, потому что его сделали темницей.
ru.B: Вельможи пришли в ярость. Они избили Иеремию и заперли его в доме царского писца Ионафана, который превратили в тюрьму.
ru.R: Начальники очень разгневались на Иеремию. Они избили его и заперли в доме Ионафана, царского писца. Они превратили его дом в тюрьму.

ja.L: 長たちはエレミヤに対して怒り、彼を打って、獄屋である書記ヨナタンの家に入れた。彼らはそこを牢獄にしていたからである。
ja.B: 高官たちはエレミヤに激しく怒り、彼を打ちたたいて、書記ヨナタンの家に閉じ込めた。彼らはそこを牢獄にしていたのである。
ja.R: 指導者たちはエレミヤにひどく腹を立て、エレミヤを打ちたたいて、王の書記ヨナタンの家に閉じ込めました。彼らは、その家を牢屋にしていたのです。

decisions.choice: the house of confinement: a place where prisoners were held
decisions.reason: The word comes from a verb meaning to bind; the phrase means a place of detention. It is explained by what follows: a private house that served as a prison.

decisions.choice: Jonathan the secretary: a senior royal official
decisions.reason: The secretary was one of the chief officers of the court, in charge of royal writing and records (36:12; 2 Kings 22:3). This man's house had been made into a jail, perhaps because the regular prison was full or because it could be closely guarded.

decisions.choice: they struck him: a beating as punishment
decisions.reason: The officials have him beaten before the matter is tried, as Pashhur had done in 20:2.

decisions.choice: princes (L); officials (B); leaders (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this word in Jeremiah (as 26:10). These are the king's chief officers, not his sons.

decisions.choice: locked him up in the house of Jonathan ... a prison
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses two words for a prison here; Balanced and Readable say it once, in the place where the house is named, so the sentence does not repeat itself. Readable adds "royal" to show whose secretary he was.

decisions.choice: Jônatas, o escrivão (L), o secretário (B), o secretário do rei (R)
decisions.reason: The royal office keeps the words 36:10 sets for it at each level (m2); "Jônatas" is the usual Brazilian form of the name.

decisions.choice: योनातान लेखक (L); योनातान सचिव (B); राजा का सचिव योनातान (R)
decisions.reason: Jonathan bears the form of Saul's son (योनातान, the history note); the royal scribe is लेखक at Literal and सचिव at Balanced and Readable, as for Shaphan and Elishama in 36.

decisions.choice: Ионафан, писец (L); царский писец Ионафан (B, R)
decisions.reason: Jonathan keeps the form used for every Jonathan in this translation; the royal scribe is worded as in 36:10-21.

decisions.choice: Yehonatan hassofer "書記ヨナタン" (L, B), "王の書記ヨナタン" (R).
decisions.reason: m2; sofer as 2 Kings.

source.text: כִּ֣י בָ֧א יִרְמְיָ֛הוּ אֶל־בֵּ֥ית הַבּ֖וֹר וְאֶל־הַֽחֲנֻ֑יוֹת וַיֵּֽשֶׁב־שָׁ֥ם יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃פ

records.literal_gloss: For came Jeremiah into [the] house of the cistern and into the vaults, and stayed there Jeremiah many days.

en.L: So Jeremiah came into the cistern house and into the vaults, and Jeremiah stayed there many days.
en.B: So Jeremiah was put in the cistern house, in its vaulted cells, and he stayed there for a long time.
en.R: So Jeremiah was put in a cell in an underground pit, and he stayed there for a long time.

es.L: Así que entró Jeremías en la casa de la cisterna y en las bóvedas, y permaneció allí Jeremías muchos días.
es.B: Así que Jeremías fue metido en la casa de la cisterna, en sus celdas abovedadas, y allí se quedó mucho tiempo.
es.R: Así que metieron a Jeremías en una celda en un pozo bajo tierra, y allí se quedó mucho tiempo.

fr.L: Ainsi Jérémie entra dans la maison de la citerne et dans les cachots voûtés, et Jérémie y resta de nombreux jours.
fr.B: Jérémie fut donc mis dans la maison de la citerne, dans ses cachots voûtés, et il y resta longtemps.
fr.R: Jérémie a donc été mis dans un cachot au fond d’une fosse, et il y est resté longtemps.

sw.L: Basi Yeremia akaingia katika nyumba ya birika, ndani ya vyumba vya chini, naye Yeremia akakaa huko siku nyingi.
sw.B: Basi Yeremia akatiwa katika nyumba ya birika, katika vyumba vyake vya chini vyenye matao, naye akakaa huko muda mrefu.
sw.R: Basi Yeremia akatiwa katika chumba ndani ya shimo chini ya ardhi, naye akakaa huko muda mrefu.

vi.L: Vậy Giê-rê-mi vào trong nhà hầm chứa nước, vào các phòng giam có vòm, và Giê-rê-mi ở đó nhiều ngày.
vi.B: Vậy Giê-rê-mi bị giam trong nhà hầm chứa nước, trong các phòng giam có vòm, và ông ở đó một thời gian dài.
vi.R: Vậy Giê-rê-mi bị giam trong một phòng dưới hầm sâu, và ông ở đó một thời gian dài.

ko.L: 그렇게 예레미야가 웅덩이 집, 곧 둥근 천장 방들에 들어가, 예레미야가 거기에 여러 날 머물렀다.
ko.B: 그렇게 예레미야는 지하 웅덩이 감옥의 둥근 천장 감방에 갇혀, 오랫동안 거기에 있었다.
ko.R: 그렇게 예레미야는 땅속 구덩이에 있는 감방에 갇혀서, 오랫동안 거기에 있었다.

pt.L: Assim Jeremias entrou na casa da cisterna e nas celas abobadadas, e Jeremias ficou ali muitos dias.
pt.B: Assim Jeremias foi posto na casa da cisterna, nas suas celas abobadadas, e ficou ali muito tempo.
pt.R: Assim Jeremias foi posto numa cela dentro de um poço debaixo da terra, e ficou ali muito tempo.

am.L: ኤርምያስም ወደ ጉድጓዱ ቤት፣ ወደ ጓዳዎቹ ገባ፤ ኤርምያስም በዚያ ብዙ ቀን ተቀመጠ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ኤርምያስ በጉድጓዱ ቤት፣ በውስጡ ባሉት ጓዳዎች ታሰረ፤ በዚያም ለረጅም ጊዜ ቆየ።

hi.L: इस प्रकार यिर्मयाह हौद के घर में और तहख़ानों में आया, और यिर्मयाह वहाँ बहुत दिनों तक रहा।
hi.B: इस प्रकार यिर्मयाह को हौद के घर में, उसकी मेहराबदार कोठरियों में डाल दिया गया, और वह वहाँ बहुत समय तक रहा।
hi.R: इस तरह यिर्मयाह को ज़मीन के नीचे के एक गड्ढे की कोठरी में डाल दिया गया, और वह वहाँ बहुत समय तक रहा।

ru.L: Так вошёл Иеремия в дом водоёма и в подземелья, и пробыл там Иеремия много дней.
ru.B: Так Иеремию посадили в подземный водоём, в его сводчатые камеры, и он пробыл там долго.
ru.R: Так Иеремию посадили в камеру в подземной яме, и он пробыл там долго.

ja.L: こうしてエレミヤは、水溜めの家、その丸天井の部屋に入り、エレミヤは長い間そこにとどまった。
ja.B: こうしてエレミヤは、地下牢の丸天井の監房に入れられ、長い間そこにいた。
ja.R: こうして、エレミヤは地下の穴の中の牢屋に入れられ、長い間そこにいました。

decisions.choice: So: the word sums up what verse 15 has told
decisions.reason: The connecting word usually means "for" or "when". Here it gathers up the account of the arrest: this is where Jeremiah ended up.

decisions.choice: the cistern house: an underground pit used as a cell
decisions.reason: The word for cistern is a pit cut in the rock to hold rainwater. Dry or emptied cisterns were used to hold prisoners (Genesis 37:24; 40:15). Jeremiah is later let down into a muddy cistern (38:6).

decisions.choice: the vaults: arched rooms or cells, probably within the cistern house
decisions.reason: The word occurs only here, and its exact sense is uncertain. It is usually linked to a root meaning to bend or to camp, which suggests vaulted or arched rooms. In later Hebrew a related word means a shop or a booth. It may name cells cut into the walls of the pit.

decisions.choice: many days: a long time
decisions.reason: The length is not given. The phrase means a long and uncertain stay.

decisions.choice: was put
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says that Jeremiah "came" into the pit; Balanced and Readable make clear that he was taken there as a prisoner (verse 15).

decisions.choice: a cell in an underground pit
decisions.reason: Readable explains the cistern house and its vaults with simple words. It follows the uncertain sense of m3.

decisions.choice: nhà hầm chứa nước; các phòng giam có vòm
decisions.reason: The cistern house is an underground pit for water used as a cell; Vietnamese names both parts. Readable says only "một phòng dưới hầm sâu", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "웅덩이 집, 곧 둥근 천장 방들" (L); "지하 웅덩이 감옥의 둥근 천장 감방" (B); "땅속 구덩이에 있는 감방" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decisions describe an underground cistern used as cells; Korean names the place and its arched cells plainly.

decisions.choice: a casa da cisterna; celas abobadadas (L, B); uma cela dentro de um poço debaixo da terra (R)
decisions.reason: The cistern (m2) is "cisterna", the word for a pit cut to hold rainwater, which 38:6 repeats. The vaults (m3) are uncertain; "celas abobadadas" follows the likely sense, arched rooms, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "የጉድጓዱ ቤት" for the cistern house; "ጓዳዎች" for the vaults
decisions.reason: An underground pit used as a cell, with arched rooms inside; "የውኃ ጉድጓድ" is kept for the cistern of 38:6.

decisions.choice: हौद का घर (L, B); ज़मीन के नीचे का गड्ढा (R); तहख़ाने, मेहराबदार कोठरियाँ
decisions.reason: The cistern (bor) is हौद, a cut tank for water, here used as a cell; in chapter 38 the same word for the pit Jeremiah is let down into is also हौद. Readable says plainly that it was an underground pit.

decisions.choice: дом водоёма, подземелья (L); подземный водоём, сводчатые камеры (B); камера в подземной яме (R)
decisions.reason: An underground pit used as a cell (meaning m2), with arched cells probably inside it (meaning m3). Literal and Balanced say "водоём", the word for the cistern of chapter 38; Readable says "подземная яма", as the English says "underground pit". The sense of the vaults is not certain.

decisions.choice: beit habbor "水溜めの家" (L, keeping bor as in 38:6), "地下牢" (B), "地下の穴の中の牢屋" (R); hachanuyot "丸天井の部屋" (L), "丸天井の監房" (B).
decisions.reason: m2; m3 (uncertain; footnoted).

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֜הוּ וַיִּקָּחֵ֗הוּ וַיִּשְׁאָלֵ֨הוּ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ בְּבֵיתוֹ֙ בַּסֵּ֔תֶר וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הֲיֵ֥שׁ דָּבָ֖ר מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ יֵ֔שׁ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר בְּיַ֥ד מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל תִּנָּתֵֽן׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And sent the king Zedekiah and took him, and asked him the king in his house in secrecy, and said: Is there a word from Yahweh? And said Jeremiah: There is. And he said: Into [the] hand of [the] king of Babylon you will be given.

en.L: Then King Zedekiah sent and took him, and the king asked him secretly in his house and said, "Is there a word from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?" And Jeremiah said, "There is." And he said, "You will be given into the hand of the king of Babylon."
en.B: Then King Zedekiah sent for him and had him brought to the palace, where he questioned him in private. "Is there any word from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?" the king asked. "There is," Jeremiah replied. "You will be handed over to the king of Babylon."
en.R: Later King Zedekiah sent for Jeremiah and had him brought to the palace. There the king asked him in secret, "Do you have a message from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?" "Yes, I do," Jeremiah answered. "You will be handed over to the king of Babylon."

es.L: Entonces el rey Sedequías envió y lo tomó, y el rey le preguntó en secreto en su casa, y dijo: «¿Hay palabra de parte {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}?». Y Jeremías dijo: «La hay». Y dijo: «En mano del rey de Babilonia serás entregado».
es.B: Después el rey Sedequías mandó a buscarlo y lo hizo llevar al palacio, donde lo interrogó en privado. «¿Hay alguna palabra de parte {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}?», preguntó el rey. «La hay», respondió Jeremías. «Serás entregado en manos del rey de Babilonia».
es.R: Más tarde el rey Sedequías mandó a buscar a Jeremías y lo hizo llevar al palacio. Allí el rey le preguntó en secreto: «¿Tienes algún mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}?». «Sí, lo tengo», respondió Jeremías. «Vas a ser entregado al rey de Babilonia».

fr.L: Puis le roi Sédécias envoya le prendre, et le roi l’interrogea en secret dans sa maison et dit : « Y a-t-il une parole de la part {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? » Et Jérémie dit : « Il y en a une. » Et il dit : « Tu seras livré dans la main du roi de Babylone. »
fr.B: Puis le roi Sédécias l’envoya chercher et le fit amener au palais, où il l’interrogea en privé. « Y a-t-il une parole de la part {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? » demanda le roi. « Oui, répondit Jérémie. Tu seras livré au roi de Babylone. »
fr.R: Plus tard, le roi Sédécias a envoyé chercher Jérémie et l’a fait amener au palais. Là, le roi lui a demandé en secret : « As-tu un message de la part {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? » « Oui, j’en ai un, a répondu Jérémie. Tu seras livré au roi de Babylone. »

sw.L: Kisha mfalme Sedekia akatuma watu, akamtwaa; mfalme akamwuliza kwa siri nyumbani mwake, akasema, "Je, liko neno kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}?" Yeremia akasema, "Liko." Akasema, "Utatiwa mkononi mwa mfalme wa Babeli."
sw.B: Kisha mfalme Sedekia akatuma watu wamlete ikulu, akamwuliza faraghani, "Je, kuna neno lolote kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}?" Yeremia akajibu, "Lipo. Utatiwa mikononi mwa mfalme wa Babeli."
sw.R: Baadaye mfalme Sedekia alituma watu wamlete Yeremia ikulu. Huko mfalme akamwuliza kwa siri, "Je, una ujumbe kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}?" Yeremia akajibu, "Ndiyo, ninao. Utatiwa mikononi mwa mfalme wa Babeli."

vi.L: Vua Sê-đê-kia sai người đem ông đến, và vua hỏi ông cách kín đáo trong cung mình rằng: "Có lời nào từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không?" Giê-rê-mi nói: "Có." Rồi ông nói: "Vua sẽ bị nộp vào tay vua Ba-by-lôn."
vi.B: Bấy giờ vua Sê-đê-kia sai người đem ông vào cung và hỏi riêng ông. Vua hỏi: "Có lời nào từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không?" Giê-rê-mi đáp: "Có. Vua sẽ bị nộp vào tay vua Ba-by-lôn."
vi.R: Sau đó vua Sê-đê-kia cho người đưa Giê-rê-mi vào cung. Tại đó vua hỏi riêng ông: "Ông có sứ điệp nào từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không?" Giê-rê-mi đáp: "Thưa có. Vua sẽ bị nộp vào tay vua Ba-by-lôn."

ko.L: 그 뒤에 시드기야 왕이 사람을 보내어 그를 데려왔고, 왕이 자기 집에서 그에게 몰래 물어 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로부터 [받은] 말씀이 있느냐?" 그러자 예레미야가 말했다. "있습니다." 그리고 그가 말했다. "임금님께서는 바빌론 왕의 손에 넘겨지실 것입니다."
ko.B: 그 뒤에 시드기야 왕이 사람을 보내어 예레미야를 왕궁으로 데려오게 하고, 은밀히 그에게 물었다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로부터 받은 말씀이 있느냐?" 예레미야가 대답했다. "있습니다. 임금님께서는 바빌론 왕의 손에 넘겨지실 것입니다."
ko.R: 얼마 뒤에 시드기야 왕이 사람을 보내어 예레미야를 왕궁으로 데려오게 했다. 왕은 아무도 모르게 그에게 물었다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 주신 말씀이 있느냐?" 예레미야가 대답했다. "예, 있습니다. 임금님께서는 바빌론 왕에게 넘겨지실 것입니다."

pt.L: Então o rei Zedequias mandou buscá-lo, e o rei lhe perguntou secretamente na sua casa, e disse: "Há alguma palavra da parte {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}?" E Jeremias disse: "Há." E disse: "Na mão do rei da Babilônia o senhor será entregue."
pt.B: Então o rei Zedequias mandou buscá-lo e o fez trazer ao palácio, onde o interrogou em particular. "Há alguma palavra da parte {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}?", perguntou o rei. "Há", respondeu Jeremias. "O senhor será entregue ao rei da Babilônia."
pt.R: Mais tarde, o rei Zedequias mandou buscar Jeremias e o fez trazer ao palácio. Ali o rei lhe perguntou em segredo: "Você tem alguma mensagem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}?" "Sim, tenho", respondeu Jeremias. "O senhor vai ser entregue ao rei da Babilônia."

am.L: ንጉሡ ሴዴቅያስም ልኮ አስመጣው፤ ንጉሡም በቤቱ በስውር፦ «{{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ቃል አለን?» ብሎ ጠየቀው። ኤርምያስም፦ «አለ» አለ። ደግሞም፦ «በባቢሎን ንጉሥ እጅ ይሰጣሉ» አለ።
am.B: ከዚያም ንጉሡ ሴዴቅያስ ልኮ ወደ ቤተ መንግሥቱ አስመጣውና በስውር ጠየቀው። «{{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} የመጣ ቃል አለን?» ብሎ ንጉሡ ጠየቀ። «አለ» ብሎ ኤርምያስ መለሰ፤ «ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ተላልፈው ይሰጣሉ።»
am.R: በኋላም ንጉሡ ሴዴቅያስ ልኮ ኤርምያስን ወደ ቤተ መንግሥቱ አስመጣው። በዚያም ንጉሡ በስውር፦ «{{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} መልእክት አለህን?» ብሎ ጠየቀው። «አዎ፣ አለኝ» ብሎ ኤርምያስ መለሰ፤ «ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ተላልፈው ይሰጣሉ።»

hi.L: तब राजा सिदकिय्याह ने भेजकर उसे बुलवा लिया, और राजा ने अपने भवन में उससे छिपकर पूछा, "क्या {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की ओर से कोई वचन है?" यिर्मयाह ने कहा, "है।" और उसने कहा, "आप बाबुल के राजा के हाथ में दिए जाएँगे।"
hi.B: तब राजा सिदकिय्याह ने उसे बुलवाकर महल में मँगवाया, और वहाँ अकेले में उससे पूछा, "क्या {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की ओर से कोई वचन है?" "है," यिर्मयाह ने उत्तर दिया। "आप बाबुल के राजा के हाथ में सौंपे जाएँगे।"
hi.R: बाद में राजा सिदकिय्याह ने यिर्मयाह को बुलवाकर महल में मँगवाया। वहाँ राजा ने उससे छिपकर पूछा, "क्या तुम्हारे पास {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का कोई संदेश है?" "हाँ, है," यिर्मयाह ने उत्तर दिया। "आप बाबुल के राजा के हाथ में सौंप दिए जाएँगे।"

ru.L: И послал царь Седекия, и взял его, и спрашивал его царь тайно в своём доме, и сказал: «Есть ли слово от {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}?» И сказал Иеремия: «Есть.» И сказал: «В руку царя Вавилона ты будешь отдан.»
ru.B: Тогда царь Седекия послал за ним и велел привести его во дворец, где тайно расспросил его. «Есть ли слово от {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}?» — спросил царь. «Есть», — ответил Иеремия. «Ты будешь отдан царю Вавилона.»
ru.R: Позже царь Седекия послал за Иеремией и велел привести его во дворец. Там царь тайно спросил его: «Есть ли у тебя слово от {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}?» «Да, есть», — ответил Иеремия. «Ты будешь отдан царю Вавилона.»

ja.L: ツィドキヤ王は人を遣わして彼を連れて来させた。王は自分の家で、ひそかに彼に尋ねて言った。「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}から言葉がありますか？」エレミヤは言った。「あります。」そして言った。「あなたはバビロンの王の手に渡されます。」
ja.B: その後、ツィドキヤ王は人を遣わしてエレミヤを王宮に連れて来させ、ひそかに彼に問いただした。「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}から何か言葉がありますか？」と王は尋ねた。「あります」とエレミヤは答えた。「あなたはバビロンの王の手に渡されます。」
ja.R: その後、ツィドキヤ王はエレミヤを呼び寄せて、王宮に連れて来させました。そして、王はひそかにエレミヤに尋ねました。「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}からのお告げはありますか？」「はい、あります」とエレミヤは答えました。「あなたは、バビロンの王に引き渡されます。」

decisions.choice: in his house, in secret: in the palace, out of sight of the officials
decisions.reason: The king's "house" is the royal palace. Zedekiah feared his own officials (38:5, 19, 24-26) and could not be seen consulting the man they had jailed as a traitor.

decisions.choice: There is ... And he said: Jeremiah gives a short answer and then the word itself
decisions.reason: Jeremiah first answers the king's question with one word; the second "he said" introduces the message. It is the same message he had given before (21:7; 32:4; 34:3).

decisions.choice: be given into the hand of: be handed over to the power of
decisions.reason: "Hand" stands for power and control. Zedekiah will be captured and brought before the king of Babylon (39:5-7).

decisions.choice: sent for him and had him brought to the palace
decisions.reason: "Sent and took him" means he had Jeremiah fetched. Balanced and Readable say so and name the place from "in his house".

decisions.choice: Yes, I do
decisions.reason: The Hebrew answer "There is" is put the natural way in plain English.

decisions.choice: vua (Jeremiah to Zedekiah); tôi (Jeremiah); ông and ta (Zedekiah)
decisions.reason: The prophet and the king speak as they do in Kings: the prophet calls the king "vua" and himself "tôi"; the king says "ông" to the prophet and "ta" for himself.

decisions.choice: The king speaks to Jeremiah in 해라체; Jeremiah answers in 합쇼체 with "임금님"
decisions.reason: The terms note: kings speak 해라체 to prophets, and a prophet speaks to a king in 합쇼체.

decisions.choice: o senhor (Jeremiah to the king); você (the king to Jeremiah)
decisions.reason: As the shared rules for Jeremiah set it, Jeremiah speaks to the king in his own voice with "o senhor", the courtesy owed a king (verse 20), and the king speaks to the prophet with "você".

decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you" is plural, the king and his people; Jeremiah's respectful speech to the king takes "여러분" at Balanced and Readable, while Literal keeps the plain plural inside the quoted words.

decisions.choice: Plural "you" "あなたがた" at R too, in Jeremiah's polite words to the king and his court (あなたたち would sound too familiar here).
decisions.reason: m3; style guide §4.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֕ה שְֽׁמַֽע־נָ֖א אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ תִּפָּל־נָ֤א תְחִנָּתִי֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְאַל־תְּשִׁבֵ֗נִי בֵּ֚ית יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן הַסֹּפֵ֔ר וְלֹ֥א אָמ֖וּת שָֽׁם׃

records.literal_gloss: And now listen please, my lord the king; let fall please my supplication before you, and do not make me return [to the] house of Jonathan the scribe, and not I will die there.

en.L: And now, please listen, my lord the king; please let my plea fall before you, and do not send me back to the house of Jonathan the secretary, so that I may not die there."
en.B: Now please listen, my lord the king. Please accept my plea: do not send me back to the house of Jonathan the secretary, or I will die there."
en.R: Now please listen to me, my lord the king. I beg you to do what I ask. Do not send me back to the house of Jonathan the secretary. If you do, I will die there."

es.L: Y ahora escucha, por favor, mi señor el rey; caiga, por favor, mi súplica delante de ti, y no me hagas volver a la casa de Jonatán el escriba, para que no muera yo allí».
es.B: Ahora, por favor, escucha, mi señor el rey. Te ruego que aceptes mi súplica: no me hagas volver a la casa de Jonatán el secretario, o moriré allí».
es.R: Ahora, por favor, escúchame, mi señor el rey. Te ruego que hagas lo que te pido. No me mandes de vuelta a la casa de Jonatán el secretario. Si lo haces, moriré allí».

fr.L: Et maintenant, écoute donc, mon seigneur le roi ; que ma supplication tombe donc devant toi, et ne me renvoie pas dans la maison de Jonathan le secrétaire, afin que je n’y meure pas. »
fr.B: Maintenant, écoute, je t’en prie, mon seigneur le roi. Accueille ma supplication : ne me renvoie pas dans la maison de Jonathan le secrétaire, sinon j’y mourrai. »
fr.R: Maintenant, écoute-moi, s’il te plaît, mon seigneur le roi. Je t’en supplie, fais ce que je te demande. Ne me renvoie pas dans la maison de Jonathan le secrétaire. Si tu le fais, j’y mourrai. »

sw.L: Basi sasa, sikiliza tafadhali, bwana wangu mfalme; tafadhali dua yangu ianguke mbele yako, wala usinirudishe katika nyumba ya Yonathani mwandishi, nisije nikafa huko."
sw.B: Basi sasa tafadhali sikiliza, bwana wangu mfalme. Tafadhali kubali ombi langu: usinirudishe katika nyumba ya Yonathani katibu, la sivyo nitakufa huko."
sw.R: Basi sasa tafadhali nisikilize, bwana wangu mfalme. Nakusihi unifanyie ninalokuomba. Usinirudishe katika nyumba ya Yonathani katibu. Ukinirudisha huko, nitakufa."

vi.L: Bây giờ, xin chúa tôi là vua hãy nghe; xin cho lời khẩn cầu của tôi thấu đến trước mặt vua, và xin đừng bắt tôi trở về nhà của Giô-na-than thư ký, kẻo tôi chết ở đó."
vi.B: Bây giờ, tâu bệ hạ, xin bệ hạ lắng nghe. Xin chấp nhận lời khẩn cầu của tôi: đừng gửi tôi trở lại nhà của Giô-na-than, thư ký triều đình, kẻo tôi chết ở đó."
vi.R: Bây giờ, tâu bệ hạ, xin bệ hạ nghe tôi. Tôi nài xin bệ hạ làm điều tôi cầu xin. Xin đừng gửi tôi trở lại nhà của Giô-na-than, thư ký hoàng gia. Nếu bệ hạ làm vậy, tôi sẽ chết ở đó."

ko.L: 이제 내 주 임금님, 들어 주십시오. 제 간구가 임금님 앞에 떨어지게 해 주십시오. 저를 서기관 요나단의 집으로 돌려보내지 마십시오. 제가 거기서 죽지 않게 해 주십시오."
ko.B: 이제 내 주 임금님, 들어 주십시오. 제 간청을 받아 주십시오. 저를 서기관 요나단의 집으로 돌려보내지 마십시오. 그러면 저는 거기서 죽고 말 것입니다."
ko.R: 이제 임금님, 제 말을 들어 주십시오. 제가 드리는 부탁을 들어주시기를 바랍니다. 저를 서기관 요나단의 집으로 돌려보내지 마십시오. 그렇게 하시면 저는 거기서 죽을 것입니다."

pt.L: E agora ouça, por favor, meu senhor, o rei; caia, por favor, a minha súplica diante do senhor, e não me faça voltar à casa de Jônatas, o escrivão, para que eu não morra ali."
pt.B: Agora, por favor, ouça, meu senhor, o rei. Aceite o meu pedido, por favor: não me mande de volta para a casa de Jônatas, o secretário, senão eu morrerei ali."
pt.R: Agora, por favor, ouça-me, meu senhor, o rei. Eu lhe peço que faça o que estou pedindo. Não me mande de volta para a casa de Jônatas, o secretário. Se o senhor fizer isso, eu vou morrer ali."

am.L: አሁንም፣ ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፣ እባክዎ ይስሙኝ፤ ልመናዬ በፊትዎ ትድረስ፤ በዚያ እንዳልሞት ወደ ጸሐፊው ወደ ዮናታን ቤት አይመልሱኝ።»
am.B: አሁንም፣ ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፣ እባክዎ ይስሙኝ። ልመናዬን ይቀበሉ፤ ወደ ጸሐፊው ወደ ዮናታን ቤት አይመልሱኝ፤ አለዚያ በዚያ እሞታለሁ።»
am.R: አሁንም፣ ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፣ እባክዎ ይስሙኝ። የምለምንዎትን እንዲያደርጉልኝ እለምንዎታለሁ። ወደ ጸሐፊው ወደ ዮናታን ቤት አይመልሱኝ። ከመለሱኝ በዚያ እሞታለሁ።»

hi.L: और अब, हे मेरे स्वामी राजा, कृपया सुनिए; कृपया मेरी विनती आपके सामने पहुँचे, और मुझे योनातान लेखक के घर में लौटने न दीजिए, ऐसा न हो कि मैं वहाँ मर जाऊँ।"
hi.B: अब, हे मेरे स्वामी राजा, कृपया सुनिए। कृपया मेरी विनती स्वीकार कीजिए: मुझे योनातान सचिव के घर में वापस न भेजिए, नहीं तो मैं वहाँ मर जाऊँगा।"
hi.R: अब, हे मेरे स्वामी राजा, कृपया मेरी बात सुनिए। मैं आपसे विनती करता हूँ कि जो मैं माँगता हूँ, वह कीजिए। मुझे योनातान सचिव के घर में वापस मत भेजिए। अगर आप भेजेंगे, तो मैं वहाँ मर जाऊँगा।"

ru.L: А теперь послушай же, господин мой царь; пусть падёт же моя мольба перед тобой, и не возвращай меня в дом Ионафана, писца, чтобы мне не умереть там.»
ru.B: А теперь, прошу, выслушай, господин мой царь. Прими мою мольбу: не возвращай меня в дом писца Ионафана, иначе я умру там.»
ru.R: А теперь, прошу, послушай меня, господин мой царь. Умоляю, сделай то, о чём я прошу. Не отправляй меня обратно в дом царского писца Ионафана. Если ты это сделаешь, я там умру.»

ja.L: 今、どうか聞いてください、わたしの主君、王よ。どうか、わたしの願いがあなたの前に受け入れられますように。わたしを書記ヨナタンの家に帰さないでください。わたしがそこで死ぬことのないためです。」
ja.B: どうか今、お聞きください、わが主君、王さま。どうか、わたしの願いを聞き入れてください。わたしを書記ヨナタンの家に送り返さないでください。そうでないと、わたしはそこで死んでしまいます。」
ja.R: どうか今、わたしの言うことを聞いてください、王さま。お願いですから、わたしの願いをかなえてください。わたしを書記ヨナタンの家に戻さないでください。もし戻されたら、わたしはそこで死んでしまいます。」

decisions.choice: let my plea fall before you: may my request be accepted
decisions.reason: A plea that "falls before" someone is laid before him and favorably received (the same phrase in 36:7; 42:2, 9).

decisions.choice: my lord the king: the respectful address of a subject
decisions.reason: Jeremiah speaks with the courtesy owed to a king, even while he protests his innocence.

decisions.choice: and I will not die there: the purpose of the request
decisions.reason: The clause gives the reason for the plea: if he is sent back, he expects to die in that prison.

decisions.choice: I beg you to do what I ask ... If you do, I will die there.
decisions.reason: Readable says what "let my plea fall before you" means and breaks the long request into short sentences.

decisions.choice: chúa tôi là vua (L); tâu bệ hạ, bệ hạ (B, R)
decisions.reason: "My lord the king" is the formal address of a subject; it follows the Vietnamese of 1 Kings 1: "chúa tôi là vua" at Literal, "bệ hạ" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "내 주 임금님" (L, B); "임금님" (R)
decisions.reason: The address published in Samuel and Kings.

decisions.choice: meu senhor, o rei; o senhor
decisions.reason: The respectful address of a subject (m2) takes the courtly words 1-2 Kings give it in Portuguese, "meu senhor, o rei", and the verbs that go with "o senhor" ("ouça", "não me mande").

decisions.choice: "ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ" with "እርስዎ" ("ይስሙኝ", "አይመልሱኝ")
decisions.reason: The Kings terms list address of a subject to his king.

decisions.choice: हे मेरे स्वामी राजा
decisions.reason: "My lord the king" keeps the history note's मेरे स्वामी राजा at every level, as the English keeps the courtly phrase.

decisions.choice: господин мой царь
decisions.reason: The respectful address of a subject (meaning m2) in the form the history note sets for every level; the courtesy is in the words, and the king is addressed as ты.

decisions.choice: 'adoni hammelekh "わたしの主君、王よ" (L), "わが主君、王さま" (B), "王さま" (R), as 2 Kings; tippol-na' techinnati lefanekha "わたしの願いがあなたの前に受け入れられますように" (L), "願いを聞き入れてください" (B), "願いをかなえてください" (R).
decisions.reason: m1, m2; the 2 Kings address.

source.text: וַיְצַוֶּ֞ה הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֗הוּ וַיַּפְקִ֣דוּ אֶֽת־יִרְמְיָהוּ֮ בַּחֲצַ֣ר הַמַּטָּרָה֒ וְנָתֹן֩ ל֨וֹ כִכַּר־לֶ֤חֶם לַיּוֹם֙ מִח֣וּץ הָאֹפִ֔ים עַד־תֹּ֥ם כָּל־הַלֶּ֖חֶם מִן־הָעִ֑יר וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ בַּחֲצַ֖ר הַמַּטָּרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And commanded the king Zedekiah, and they committed Jeremiah in [the] court of the guard, and giving to him a round of bread for the day from [the] street of the bakers, until finished all the bread from the city. And remained Jeremiah in [the] court of the guard.

en.L: And King Zedekiah gave orders, and they committed Jeremiah to the court of the guard, and a loaf of bread was given to him each day from the bakers' street, until all the bread in the city was gone. And Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard.
en.B: So King Zedekiah gave orders, and Jeremiah was placed in the court of the guard. Each day he was given a loaf of bread from the street of the bakers, until there was no bread left in the city. And Jeremiah stayed in the court of the guard.
en.R: So King Zedekiah gave orders, and Jeremiah was kept in the courtyard of the palace guard. Every day he was given a loaf of bread from the street where the bakers worked, until all the bread in the city was used up. So Jeremiah stayed in the courtyard of the guard.

es.L: Y mandó el rey Sedequías, y pusieron a Jeremías en el patio de la guardia, y le daban una torta de pan cada día de la calle de los panaderos, hasta que se acabó todo el pan de la ciudad. Y quedó Jeremías en el patio de la guardia.
es.B: Entonces el rey Sedequías dio órdenes, y pusieron a Jeremías en el patio de la guardia. Cada día le daban una torta de pan de la calle de los panaderos, hasta que no quedó pan en la ciudad. Y Jeremías se quedó en el patio de la guardia.
es.R: Así que el rey Sedequías dio órdenes, y dejaron a Jeremías en el patio de la guardia del palacio. Todos los días le daban una torta de pan de la calle donde trabajaban los panaderos, hasta que se acabó todo el pan de la ciudad. Así que Jeremías se quedó en el patio de la guardia.

fr.L: Et le roi Sédécias donna des ordres, et on confia Jérémie à la cour de la garde, et on lui donnait chaque jour une miche de pain de la rue des boulangers, jusqu’à ce que tout le pain de la ville fût épuisé. Et Jérémie resta dans la cour de la garde.
fr.B: Le roi Sédécias donna donc des ordres, et l’on plaça Jérémie dans la cour de la garde. Chaque jour, on lui donnait une miche de pain de la rue des boulangers, jusqu’à ce qu’il n’y ait plus de pain dans la ville. Et Jérémie resta dans la cour de la garde.
fr.R: Le roi Sédécias a donc donné des ordres, et on a gardé Jérémie dans la cour de la garde du palais. Chaque jour, on lui donnait une miche de pain qui venait de la rue des boulangers, jusqu’à ce que tout le pain de la ville soit épuisé. C’est ainsi que Jérémie est resté dans la cour de la garde.

sw.L: Ndipo mfalme Sedekia akaamuru, nao wakamweka Yeremia katika ua wa walinzi, naye akapewa mkate mmoja kila siku kutoka katika mtaa wa waokaji, mpaka mikate yote ya mji ikaisha. Basi Yeremia akakaa katika ua wa walinzi.
sw.B: Basi mfalme Sedekia akatoa amri, naye Yeremia akawekwa katika ua wa walinzi. Kila siku alipewa mkate mmoja kutoka katika mtaa wa waokaji, mpaka mikate yote ikaisha mjini. Basi Yeremia akakaa katika ua wa walinzi.
sw.R: Basi mfalme Sedekia akatoa amri, naye Yeremia akawekwa katika ua wa walinzi wa ikulu. Kila siku alipewa mkate mmoja kutoka katika mtaa ambamo waokaji walifanya kazi, mpaka mikate yote ya mji ikaisha. Kwa hiyo Yeremia akakaa katika ua wa walinzi.

vi.L: Vua Sê-đê-kia ra lệnh, và người ta giao Giê-rê-mi vào sân vệ binh, và mỗi ngày cấp cho ông một ổ bánh từ phố những người làm bánh, cho đến khi hết sạch bánh trong thành. Vậy Giê-rê-mi ở lại trong sân vệ binh.
vi.B: Vậy vua Sê-đê-kia ra lệnh, và Giê-rê-mi được giữ trong sân vệ binh. Mỗi ngày ông được cấp một ổ bánh từ phố những người làm bánh, cho đến khi trong thành không còn bánh nữa. Vậy Giê-rê-mi ở lại trong sân vệ binh.
vi.R: Vậy vua Sê-đê-kia ra lệnh, và Giê-rê-mi bị giữ trong sân của lính canh hoàng cung. Mỗi ngày ông được cấp một ổ bánh từ con phố nơi những người làm bánh làm việc, cho đến khi bánh trong thành hết sạch. Vậy Giê-rê-mi ở lại trong sân của lính canh.

ko.L: 그래서 시드기야 왕이 명령하여, 그들이 예레미야를 경비대 뜰에 맡기고, 성 안에 빵이 다 떨어질 때까지 빵 굽는 사람들의 거리에서 날마다 빵 한 덩이씩 그에게 주게 했다. 그리하여 예레미야가 경비대 뜰에 머물렀다.
ko.B: 그래서 시드기야 왕이 명령을 내려, 예레미야를 경비대 뜰에 두게 했다. 그리고 성 안에 빵이 다 떨어질 때까지 날마다 빵 굽는 사람들의 거리에서 빵 한 덩이씩 그에게 주게 했다. 이렇게 예레미야는 경비대 뜰에 머물렀다.
ko.R: 그래서 시드기야 왕은 명령을 내려, 예레미야를 왕궁 경비대의 뜰에 가두어 두게 했다. 그리고 성 안의 빵이 다 떨어질 때까지 날마다 빵 굽는 사람들이 일하는 거리에서 빵 한 덩이씩 그에게 주게 했다. 이렇게 예레미야는 경비대 뜰에서 지냈다.

pt.L: E o rei Zedequias deu ordem, e confiaram Jeremias ao pátio da guarda, e lhe davam um pão redondo por dia, da rua dos padeiros, até que se acabou todo o pão da cidade. E Jeremias permaneceu no pátio da guarda.
pt.B: Então o rei Zedequias deu ordens, e Jeremias foi colocado no pátio da guarda. Todos os dias ele recebia um pão da rua dos padeiros, até que não houve mais pão na cidade. E Jeremias ficou no pátio da guarda.
pt.R: Então o rei Zedequias deu ordens, e Jeremias ficou preso no pátio da guarda do palácio. Todos os dias ele recebia um pão da rua onde os padeiros trabalhavam, até que todo o pão da cidade acabou. Assim Jeremias ficou no pátio da guarda.

am.L: ንጉሡ ሴዴቅያስም አዘዘ፤ ኤርምያስንም በዘበኞቹ አደባባይ አስጠበቁት፤ በከተማዪቱ ያለው እንጀራ ሁሉ እስኪያልቅ ድረስ በየቀኑ ከዳቦ ጋጋሪዎች መንገድ አንድ ዳቦ ይሰጠው ነበር። ኤርምያስም በዘበኞቹ አደባባይ ተቀመጠ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ንጉሡ ሴዴቅያስ አዘዘ፤ ኤርምያስም በዘበኞቹ አደባባይ እንዲቆይ ተደረገ። በከተማዪቱ እንጀራ ሁሉ እስኪያልቅ ድረስ በየቀኑ ከዳቦ ጋጋሪዎች መንገድ አንድ ዳቦ ይሰጠው ነበር። ኤርምያስም በዘበኞቹ አደባባይ ቆየ።
am.R: ስለዚህ ንጉሡ ሴዴቅያስ ትእዛዝ ሰጠ፤ ኤርምያስም በቤተ መንግሥቱ ዘበኞች አደባባይ እንዲቆይ ተደረገ። በከተማዪቱ ያለው እንጀራ ሁሉ እስኪያልቅ ድረስ በየቀኑ ዳቦ ጋጋሪዎች ከሚሠሩበት መንገድ አንድ ዳቦ ይሰጠው ነበር። ስለዚህ ኤርምያስ በዘበኞቹ አደባባይ ቆየ።

hi.L: तब राजा सिदकिय्याह ने आज्ञा दी, और उन्होंने यिर्मयाह को पहरे के आँगन में रखा, और नानबाइयों की गली से उसे प्रतिदिन एक रोटी दी जाती थी, जब तक नगर की सारी रोटी समाप्त न हो गई। और यिर्मयाह पहरे के आँगन में रहा।
hi.B: इसलिए राजा सिदकिय्याह ने आज्ञा दी, और यिर्मयाह को पहरे के आँगन में रखा गया। जब तक नगर में रोटी बची रही, तब तक उसे नानबाइयों की गली से हर दिन एक रोटी दी जाती रही। और यिर्मयाह पहरे के आँगन में रहा।
hi.R: इसलिए राजा सिदकिय्याह ने आज्ञा दी, और यिर्मयाह को महल के पहरे के आँगन में रखा गया। जब तक नगर की सारी रोटी ख़त्म न हो गई, तब तक उसे हर दिन उस गली से एक रोटी दी जाती रही जहाँ नानबाई काम करते थे। इस तरह यिर्मयाह पहरे के आँगन में रहा।

ru.L: И повелел царь Седекия, и поместили Иеремию во дворе стражи, и давали ему лепёшку хлеба в день с улицы пекарей, пока не кончился весь хлеб в городе. И оставался Иеремия во дворе стражи.
ru.B: Тогда царь Седекия распорядился, и Иеремию поместили во дворе стражи. Каждый день ему давали лепёшку хлеба с улицы пекарей, пока в городе не кончился весь хлеб. И Иеремия оставался во дворе стражи.
ru.R: Тогда царь Седекия отдал приказ, и Иеремию стали держать во дворе стражи при дворце. Каждый день ему давали лепёшку хлеба с той улицы, где работали пекари, пока в городе не кончился весь хлеб. Так Иеремия остался во дворе стражи.

ja.L: そこでツィドキヤ王は命じて、エレミヤを監視の庭に預け、町からすべてのパンがなくなるまで、パン屋の通りから毎日パン一つを彼に与えさせた。こうしてエレミヤは監視の庭にとどまった。
ja.B: そこでツィドキヤ王は命令を下し、エレミヤは監視の庭に置かれることになった。町のパンが尽きるまで、彼には毎日、パン屋通りから丸いパンが一つずつ与えられた。こうしてエレミヤは監視の庭にとどまった。
ja.R: そこで、ツィドキヤ王は命令を出しました。エレミヤは王宮の監視の庭に置かれることになりました。そして、町のパンがすべてなくなるまで、毎日、パン屋が集まっている通りから、パンが一つずつエレミヤに届けられました。こうして、エレミヤは監視の庭にとどまりました。

decisions.choice: the court of the guard: an open courtyard by the palace where prisoners were held
decisions.reason: It was a guarded enclosure attached to the royal palace (32:2). It was far less harsh than the cistern: there Jeremiah could receive visitors and do business (32:8-12).

decisions.choice: a loaf was given to him: a standing order
decisions.reason: The verb is an infinitive with no stated subject, describing a regular daily supply. The king provides for him without setting him free.

decisions.choice: until all the bread was gone: the famine at the end of the siege
decisions.reason: When the siege resumed, the food in the city ran out shortly before it fell (38:9; 52:6; 2 Kings 25:3).

decisions.choice: the bakers' street: the quarter where the bakers worked
decisions.reason: Ancient cities often had streets named after the trade carried on there.

decisions.choice: the courtyard of the palace guard
decisions.reason: Readable says "courtyard" and adds "palace" so that the reader can picture where Jeremiah was held.

decisions.choice: he was given
decisions.reason: The Hebrew's impersonal "giving" is put in the passive at every level; Literal keeps the order of the Hebrew clauses.

decisions.choice: el patio de la guardia
decisions.reason: "Patio" is used for this open court of the palace guard, as in 32:2 and through chapters 38-39; "atrio" stays for the temple courts.

decisions.choice: "ua wa walinzi" (L, B); "ua wa walinzi wa ikulu" (R)
decisions.reason: The court of the guard is named for the guards who kept it; Readable adds that it was by the palace, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "la cour de la garde"
decisions.reason: The open court by the palace where prisoners were held, named the same way at every level through chapters 37-39; Readable adds "du palais" as the English does.

decisions.choice: sân vệ binh (L, B); sân của lính canh hoàng cung (R)
decisions.reason: The court of the guard was an open courtyard by the palace where prisoners were kept under watch; the same words are used through chapters 32-39.

decisions.choice: "경비대 뜰" (L, B); "왕궁 경비대의 뜰" (R) for the court of the guard
decisions.reason: A plain modern name for the guarded courtyard where Jeremiah was held through chapters 32-39.

decisions.choice: "ዳቦ" for the loaf, "እንጀራ" for bread as food in "all the bread in the city"
decisions.reason: The New Testament distinction in the style brief: እንጀራ for bread as food, ዳቦ for loaves.

decisions.choice: पहरे का आँगन
decisions.reason: The court of the guard keeps the wording of 32:2; Readable adds महल, as the English adds "palace". The bakers are नानबाई, the Hindi word for those who bake bread for sale.

decisions.choice: двор стражи; лепёшка хлеба; улица пекарей
decisions.reason: The court of the guard as in 32:2; a loaf is "лепёшка", the flat round bread of the time.

decisions.choice: chatsar hammattarah "監視の庭" (every level, as 33:1); kikkar lechem "パン一つ" (L), "丸いパンが一つ" (B), "パンが一つ" (R); chuts ha'ofim "パン屋の通り" (L), "パン屋通り" (B), "パン屋が集まっている通り" (R).
